'''Sesfan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] who served as [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar's]] representative on the Council.

==Biography==
Sesfan served in the [[Mon Cal Fleet|Mon Calamari space fleet]] before joining [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. He was [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] operator on Ackbar's [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. He was soon promoted to the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] and became Ackbar's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] and his representative to the [[New Republic Ruling Council]].<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>

Sesfan was heavier than was typical of Mon Calamari and his skin was paler than normal. It was thought he might have a case of [[Mon Calamari Nerveshock]] but medical test were negative.<ref name="TTS" />

==Personality and traits==
Sesfan had the typical Mon Calamari respect for law and order, and a strong dislike for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="TTS" />
